title: Korean edition of Imaginative Realism
content: A Korean edition ofImaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't Existis in the works and should be out in a few months.Maquettes and painting of theProtoceratopsBixThis page talks about using maquettes for reference. The small maquette of Bix is on display in the "Art of James Gurney" museum exhibitionin Philadelphia.------Previously:Color and Lightin Japanese, Chinese, and Koreanandalso here.
